crossRefs.note: You inhabitants of Moab, leave the cities, and dwell in the rock. Be like the dove that makes her nest over the mouth…
In Yahweh, I take refuge. How can you say to my soul, “Flee as a bird to your mountain”?
I said, “Oh that I had wings like a dove! Then I would fly away, and be at rest.
For it will be that as wandering birds, as a scattered nest, so will the daughters of Moab be at the fords of the Arnon.
Two wings of the great eagle were given to the woman, that she might fly into the wilderness to her place, so that she…
You daughter who dwells in Egypt, furnish yourself to go into captivity; for Memphis will become a desolation, and will…
Therefore as I live, says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, surely Moab will be as Sodom, and the children of Ammon…

people.name: Moab
people.line: Ancient kingdom east of the Dead Sea in Jordan

translations.web: Give wings to Moab, that she may fly and get herself away: and her cities will become a desolation, without anyone to dwell in them.
translations.bsb: Put salt on Moab, for she will be laid waste; her cities will become desolate, with no one to dwell in them.
translations.kjv: Give wings unto Moab, that it may flee and get away: for the cities thereof shall be desolate, without any to dwell therein.
translations.asv: Give wings unto Moab, that she may fly and get her away: and her cities shall become a desolation, without any to dwell therein.
